title: FVCBankcorp, Inc. Announces Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Earnings; 46% Increase in Net Income Compared to Prior Year
summary: FVCBankcorp, Inc. (NASDAQ: FVCB) (the “Company”) today reported net income of $5.6 million for the quarter ended December 31, 2025 compared to net income of $4.9 million for the quarter ended December 31, 2024, an increase of $747 thousand, or 15%. Diluted earnings per share were $0.31 for the quarter ended December 31, 2025 compared to $0.26 for the quarter ended December 31, 2024, an increase of 19%. For the year ended December 31, 2025, the Company reported net income of $22.1 million, or $1.21 diluted earnings per share, an increase of $7.0 million, or 46%, compared to net income of $15.1 million, or $0.82 diluted earnings per share, for the year ended December 31, 2024. Fourth Quarter Selected Financial Highlights Pre-tax Pre-provision Operating Income Grows 32% Year-Over-Year.
